guide.title: Mukammal Ziyarat Guide
guide.subtitle: Muqaddas maqamat ke liye ek bharpoor, baadab guide - Makkah, Umrah o Hajj ke marahil, mubarak maqamat, Taif, Madinah aur Badr - har zaban mein dastyaab, muft parhne aur download ke liye.
guide.intro: Chahe ye aapki pehli Ziyarat ho ya daswin, ye guide aap ko muqaddas maqamat aur unki tareekh se roshnaas karati hai taake aapki Ziyarat baamani aur baailm ho. Shuru karne ke liye neeche apni zaban muntakhib karein.

makkah.title: Makkah
makkah.desc: Muqaddas sheher, Ka'bah aur Masjid al-Haram ka taaruf.

umrah.title: Umrah, Marhala War
umrah.desc: Umrah ke manasik waazeh tor par, tarteeb se.

sacredSites.title: Makkah ke Muqaddas Maqamat

taif.title: Taif
taif.desc: Paharri sheher aur Nabi ﷺ ki zindagi mein uska maqam.

madinah.title: Madinah
madinah.desc: Nabi ﷺ ka sheher, Masjid an-Nabawi aur uski Ziyarat.

badr.title: Badr
badr.desc: Pehli barri jang ka maqam aur uske shuhada.

family.title: Nabi ﷺ ka Khandan
family.desc: Nabi ﷺ ki azwaj o aulad ke bare mein zameema.

guide.contentPending: Is baab ka mukammal matn - bashumool Qurani ayaat, ahadith aur unke maakhaz - tasdeeq aur janch ke baad yahan shaya kiya jayega. Hum har lafz ki durustagi ka bohat khayal rakhte hain. Barah-e-karam jald dobara aayein, ya agar aap content ki janch mein madad karna chahein to rabta karein.
guide.machineNotice: Ye tarjuma machine ki madad se tayyar karda draft hai, ilmi nazar-sani ke muntazir. Arabi ayaat o ahadith bighair tabdeeli ke hain; baaz naam abhi local zaban mein muntaqil nahi hue.
guide.verifyNote: Tamam Qurani ayaat aur ahadith ishaat se pehle mustanad maakhaz se tasdeeq ki jati hain.
